notes: DRAFT. No act in force prescribes this document's form. The Normele pentru efectuarea operațiunilor de casă în economia națională (HG 764/1992), which named the 'dispoziţii de încasări' and 'dispoziţii de plată' (pct. 12-13), the cash book ('registrul de casă', pct. 18) and the register of cash orders (pct. 21), and whose pct. 11 left the standard forms to the statistics department with the Ministry of Finance, were abrogated by HG 326/2021 pct. 3 (in force 19.12.2021), with nothing in their place. The Ministry of Finance has approved no typified form for them: a legis.md search of titles containing 'formularelor tipizate' (140 acts, 22.10.2026) lists none for cash; a search for 'operațiunilor de casă' finds only HG 764/1992, its amendments and the National Bank's acts for banks. Law 287/2017 art. 11 alin. (4) lets the entity draw up its own primary documents, with the mandatory elements of alin. (7) and others it needs (alin. (8)); art. 15 alin. (2) the same for registers, with the elements of alin. (3). This form is that: every field cites the sentence that makes it mandatory, or alin. (8) where the entity adds it. Cash settlements themselves are governed by Law 34/2024 (in force 01.04.2025): the limits of art. 5 (in the rule sets as cash.limits.*) and the conditions of art. 7, of which alin. (2) says what a payment document names. Every amendment found: legis.md lists versions of Law 287/2017 from 12.12.2018, 01.01.2019, 20.04.2020, 01.01.2021, 01.01.2024, 16.06.2024, 01.01.2025 and 01.01.2027; art. 11 and 15 are the same in all of them since alin. (7^1) of art. 11 was introduced by LP302/2018 (in force 12.12.2018), apart from spelling in the 2027 version. Law 34/2024 has versions from 01.01.2025 and 01.04.2025: art. 7 is the same in both; LP55/2025 rewrote art. 5 alin. (1) lit. e) and f), art. 6 lit. d) and added art. 11 alin. (1^1), and art. 11 alin. (1) moved the entry into force from 1 January to 1 April 2025. Art. 11 alin. (14) forbids corrections in documents that justify cash operations: a posted order is never changed, it is cancelled. The chitanță the old norms tore off a receipt order is not encoded: no act in force requires it. Not checked by a licensed accountant.
